clips.title: The story
paras: At the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus, Argent Guard Manados watches for corruption across Kalimdor. He serves the Argent Dawn and sends adventurers toward Blackfathom Deeps.

Argent Guard Manados keeps the Argent Dawn's watch in Darnassus. While most of the order guards Lordaeron against the Scourge, he stands among the artisans and tradefolk of the Craftsmen's Terrace. His post lets him watch for threats to northern Kalimdor's balance. When word reaches him that the Twilight's Hammer has gained a foothold beneath Ashenvale's waves, he calls on capable heroes to strike at Blackfathom Deeps and recover the cult's artifacts of dark devotion.
